notes.title: v2.3.0 (new monsters, new events, new traits!)
notes.content:
New weekends: Crack in the Aether and Fused and Furious
New monsters: Lapis Manalis and Maestro Malaperi
New traits: Bide, Bug Zapper, Feast, Harmony, Unity												
Add hidden stats page
Add calendar of events to player's guide
Tons of fixes

notes.title: v2.2.0 (Accursed Dominion)
notes.content:
- Accursed Dominion event will run Nov 22-26 with 9 new monsters!
- List traits in learned order on monster info page.
- Change insta-kills (Bushido, Vainglory) to not proc against own team.
- Fix description of Mega HP potion.
- Fix offline progress dialog to show for time warps (it gave rewards you just couldn't see it.)

notes.title: v2.1.1
notes.content:
- Add 6 hour time warp.
- Allow fusing into a monster while it’s vaulted.
- Fix Legendary rarification preview.
- Fix first transformer tutorial message.

notes.title: New building!
notes.content:
- NEW BUILDING: Alchemist. Transform and Condense potions into mega and multi-potions. Sacrifice monsters to the Rarifier for a monster of a higher rarity.
- Keep for next tribute in the auto-scrapper will now keep dummies until the tribute is fully satisfied by dummies.
- Fix position of tooltips on high resolutions.

notes.title: v2.0.9
notes.content:
- Activate Dark Carnival aether event for Sep 10.
- Add 30% off time warp sale to Wednesday promo rotation.
- Fix not being able to reach outpost flags at certain resolutions.
- Prevent using promo codes before reach first outpost and have a full team because DANCINGINSEPTEMBER caused early tutorial to break.
- Fix Generational Wealth IV and V unlocking too early (congrats if you got them early, you'll retain them afaik.)
- Change upgradable boost IAP buttons to say MAX when they're maxed instead of just graying out.

notes.title: v2.0.8
notes.content:
- Give bag space for ascending (3 for reaching dim 2, 3 for dim 3, 4 for dim 4, 1 thereafter.)
- Add new potion: Avoid potion. It's available from Apothecary, world drops, and the shop.
- Reduce effect of Defense potions a little. Large now reduces damage by 50% instead of 75%. (I'm making room for mega potions, forgive me.)
- Fix Merchant tutorial message to indicate that scrapping becomes profitable at lvl 4 (it previously said 9.)
- Fix boss special attack damage to be reduced by Connoisseur.
- Fix being able to use a scroll when all of your teams are dead.

notes.title: Achievements! (Also Pirate's Cove starts today)
notes.content:
- Add 100 Steam achievements. We actually have 110 in the game but we're limited to 100 on Steam right now. Will add the others if our limit is ever bumped.
- Fix typo on ascent consent screen.
- Change wording of ascension quest to indicate that you must reach a particular dimension, not just ascend a certain number of times (Wormholes are a relatively new feature, which made the old wording inaccurate.)

I won't be surprised if there are some issues with the Steam achievements. Please send bug reports to sayhello@purplepwny.com. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: v2.0.4
notes.content:
- Adjust the way stat randomization works to make the highest speed value more achievable (it's equally as likely as every other value now.) A less consequential side-effect of this change is that the highest achievable natural values for VIT/STR/INT have increased by 1.
- Rename Farm Mode to Hold Mode to better align with what it does.
- Require confirmation click for switching between Push Mode and Hold Mode.
- Change auto-scrapper to keep monsters for the next tribute if one is currently in progress.
- Show Aether monsters and traits in player's guide while an event is running.
- Change the message that pops up for corrupted saves to better explain the options for Steam players.

notes.title: v2.0.3
notes.content:
- Fix event scheduling code, hopefully. Wealthy Weekend was not supposed to become Dummy Daze last Sunday, but I recently rewrote that code and expected it to be kinda broken, and it was! This might be better. If so, Wealthy Weekend will run this upcoming Saturday, Aug 7 at 12AM GMT.
- Limit framerate to monitor refresh rate. This is meant to address resource usage concerns from players, as previously the game was just running as fast as it could.
- Require confirmatory second click for furthest map fast travel.
- Improve the selection of monsters that get equipped upon unlocking the second team.

I'm aware of memory leak reports from some players after running the game for a while and am investigating.

After I fix a few more Steam-specific concerns I'll be moving on to some new features. Thanks for playing the game! Feel free to send any bug reports to sayhello@purplepwny.com.

notes.title: Another locale fix!
notes.content: Interesting that these bugs never came up on the mobile release, but hey, that's what Early Access is for. This build fixes another locale bug that presented around the abbreviation of numbers. Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Fix for certain locales
notes.content: Players with certain locales were not able to get past the tutorial due to a locale-specific number parsing error. This should be fixed now. Thank you for the quick report.
